notes.title: HSVR - Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[i]Hunting Simulator VR will be getting major update within next two weeks. Main game mechanics are already finished and the only thing that's left there is to improve artificial intelligence. 

That's being said, next update will include much smarter animal AI, complete gutting system and improved teleportation system.

Once HSVR reaches version 2.0, our price will be increased to $14.99. There's also going to be a 2 weeks sale with 25% off starting on May 30th.[/i]

Keep posted!

notes.title: HSVR - Update 1.40 Lakeside Cabin
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am happy to announce that the Update 1.40 is now [b]LIVE [/b]and ready for the download! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33965908/6ba1f4fc54cd3a404511d7afd1c73f208163653f.jpg[/img]
I apologize for almost a month-long disappearance. Please understand that Riverside Sports is a one-man team. Yet working on HSVR isn't my full-time job. Either way, as I said initially, updates for the game will keep coming and I won't stop until I feel comfortable with its state.

[h1]Update Notes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] New Level: Lakeside Cabin
[*] Graphical Improvements
[*] Minor code (performance) optimization
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33965908/f53f6253ed8323cde586259dc04ebc5cda0f8e25.jpg[/img]

Please report your performance issues in our community discussions, as well as bugs & glitches you may find. Your feedback is important to us. 

[b]Thanks and happy hunting![/b]

notes.title: HSVR - Update 1.30
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am happy to announce that the Update 1.30 is now LIVE and ready for the download!

[h1]Update Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Player's Health System
[*]Player's Hunger System
[*]Cooking System
[*]Consumption System
[*]World Improvements
[/list]

[i]Although this update might seem minor for some of you, trust me, it took quite some time and was well worth it. Now, you have your own health system (to be expanded), as well as a hunger system. As time goes by, your hunger will deplete. When hunger reaches zero, your health will start to deplete as well.

Hence where Cooking System comes handy. In the future (next update), you will be able to harvest meat from killed animals. When you have raw meat on hand, you will be able to cook and then consume it.

Cooking System and Consuming System's are now implemented. So, head to the kitchen, fry it up and eat it! You deserve it! Your hunger will increase, as well as your health!

In all honesty. I am very excited about HSVR. I have many ideas that I would love to implement & as time permits, I will.[/i]

[b]Thanks and happy hunting![/b]

notes.title: HSVR - Update 1.25

Hello everyone,

Update 1.25  is now [b]LIVE [/b]and ready for the download.

[list]
[*] Improved passive A.I.
[*] New Predator A.I. Logic

notes.title: Patch 1.20.1218
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Patch is now [b]LIVE[/b] and ready for the download. 

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed User Interface issues.
[*] Increased weapons and attachments interaction distance.
[*] Now, weapons stay on hand on pickup but attachments drop on release.
[*] Improved teleportation system.
[*] Fixed and improved Animal AI.
[/list]

[h1]Note: [/h1]

[i]If you are still having issues with picking up weapons from the group, please make sure to recalibrate your HTC Vive (Room Setup). Animals still need some work, but our next update will be specifically focused on improving animal behavior. Happy Hunting!
[/i]
